span.p:
decode
opcode = word[15:13]
delay = word[12:8]
operand = word[7:0]
side = operand[7]
side_pin = operand[6:5]
side_val = operand[4]
own = operand[3:0]

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 360px; text-align: center;

span.p:
rc reg, 5 bits
rst → 0
pc_en & REPEAT → rc_next
rc_next = rc == 0 ? delay : rc − 1

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 360px; text-align: center;

span.p:
pc reg, 9 bits
rst → 0
pc_en & pc_jmp → operand
pc_en & pc_back → pc − operand
pc_en otherwise → pc + 1 + pc_skip
